tasks.title: Add the speech family spec map and the shared speech DTOs
tasks.dod: unit tests prove family matching, control descriptors, settingsFor clamping, limit precedence, pricing unit, billedChars and the estimate

tasks.title: Build the SpeechProvider port and the OpenRouter speech adapter
tasks.dod: adapter unit tests over recorded fixtures prove the catalog mapping for all 36 models, per-family request bodies, PCM vs mp3 request, credits, cost lookup and error mapping; the catalog caches 10 min

tasks.title: Wrap raw PCM as a WAV file
tasks.dod: unit tests prove a valid 44-byte RIFF/WAVE header for the given rate/channels, the default 24 000 Hz mono, unchanged samples, and a thrown conversion error for odd-length or empty data

tasks.title: Give the file store single-file audio staging, trash and one combined boot sweep
tasks.dod: file-store tests prove stage→commit, discard, trash→restore, trash→purge for audio and that one sweep restores interrupted image and audio deletions before wiping staging and drops orphan audio files; image tests unchanged and green

tasks.title: Generalise cost sync over an injected repo and lookup
tasks.dod: createCostSync takes {repo, lookupFor}; image wiring passes lookupFor from the provider registry; every existing cost-sync and image cost test passes with only constructor calls edited

tasks.title: Write the recordings repo over the rebuilt table
tasks.dod: repo integration tests prove insertAtomic with a commit callback (rollback on throw), list newest first with cursor/limit, get, deleteAtomic with a file step, listPendingCosts and resolveCost honouring the status CHECK; rows zod-parsed

tasks.title: Build the audio service: validate, speak, save atomically, track cost, delete
tasks.dod: service integration tests with a fake SpeechProvider prove every flow-1 branch (refused input, provider error/timeout, conversion/save failure → nothing left, saved with known/pending/unavailable + estimate + tracking), delete success/failure/missing, and list with modelName fallback

tasks.title: Expose the audio contract, wire it in createApp and retire the prototype server code
tasks.dod: route integration tests prove every operation of contracts/openapi.yaml with the shared schemas (incl. 403 for a foreign origin on each), boot wiring (one sweep with both id sets, audio cost resume), and the prototype server files are gone; full gate green

tasks.title: Group the navigation into Image and Audio and move Speech under /audio
tasks.dod: component tests prove two groups in order with entries, the current entry marked, the /speech alias replaced by /audio/speech, image addresses unchanged and Speech kept mounted

tasks.title: Show speech prices, estimates and recording costs honestly
tasks.dod: unit + component tests prove every estimate wording, two significant digits, «< $0.0001», «Free», per-output and unknown wording, and the cost label for known/pending/unavailable with and without an estimate

tasks.title: Build ModelSelect, VoiceSelect and descriptor-driven VoiceControls
tasks.dod: component tests prove grouping by maker with price/limit, voice filtering above 20, provider default + typed voice for voice-less models, only the model's controls rendered from descriptors, steps labels, Reset to the model's defaults leaving voice and text

tasks.title: Rebuild the Speech page on the new contract
tasks.dod: component tests prove compose/validation/working/provider-error/save-error/not-configured/models-error states, one request per click, state kept across navigation, result autoplay + download, credits refresh; prototype shared/audio.ts and old api methods deleted; full gate green

tasks.title: List recent recordings with reuse, delete and live pending costs
tasks.dod: component tests prove the ten latest with all fields, loading/empty/error, 10 s refresh only while a cost is pending, reuse filling the form, the replace confirm, the model-gone notice, delete confirm/busy/failure and removal

tasks.title: Prove the audio NFRs and the image/audio separation
tasks.dod: timing tests meet the §6 thresholds and cross-context tests prove recordings stay out of every image list and the key never appears in answers, rows or settings
